properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony's idea, 2026-08-15, in his words: "maybe reflow2 needs a /feedback skill to insert feedback into the graph. we have a few capture type skills already and we've used a brainstorm at times, and we have mass ingest. the thing with feedback is you don't know if it is an idea or test results or maybe it's a word by your boss on something — my point being, the feedback skill needs to determine intent/content to properly address. like I said, we have a lot of already existing skills, so this probably isn't a create-from-scratch effort, but a question of how to quickly capture external feedback in the graph."

DELIBERATELY DISTINCT FROM THE THREE NODES THE GUARD NAMED, all of which are about feedback LEAVING: `dec:idea-agent-to-agent-feedback-is-a-formal-channel` (should agents write reports for other agents), `req:agent-authored-feedback-is-reproducible-and-never-leaves-unasked` (nothing leaves without the human's word), `fact:second-user-report-2026-08-11` (one such report's content). THIS IS THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION — somebody else's report arriving, and what it becomes once it is here. Nothing in the design covers intake.

⭐ EVIDENCE FROM DOING IT BY HAND, TWICE, TODAY. This session processed two external feedback documents — a Grok session's 14 items and a US-government genesis session's 4 — and INVENTED THE SAME ROUTING BOTH TIMES with nothing to consult: verify each claim against the running build; `search_design` for an existing node before writing; defects to `TemporalFact` per `dec:defects-are-temporal-facts`; open questions to `proposed` Decisions; ideas via brainstorm; provenance via Fragments and `YIELDED`. That is knowledge re-derived per session — the exact failure `fact:defect-a-pre-served-skills-install-is-stranded` names as reflow2's own reason to exist. It is also the shape that produced `link-projects`: a process performed ad hoc, noticed, and made a served skill.

⭐⭐ THE SHARPENING, AND IT IS NOT WHAT THE QUESTION ASSUMES. He frames the discriminator as CONTENT — idea vs test result vs boss's word. Measured against what actually happened, the harder discriminator is AUTHORITY. The same sentence routes differently depending on who said it: "this should be civil-date, not UTC" from a user is an observation; from the design's owner it MOVES A STATUS. Moving a status is precisely what an agent may not do on its own (`dec:certainty-derived`). reflow2 already models this — `Contributor`, and `AUTHORED_BY` with `role: author | reviewer | approver` — and NOTHING READS IT AT INTAKE. A skill routing on content alone would take a boss's ruling and file it as somebody's opinion.

⭐⭐ AND THE FIRST STEP IS NOT RECORDING, IT IS VERIFYING. Of the 18 items processed today, FOUR were wrong as stated: `get_instructions` truncating (it was the client's cap), the export needing the server stopped (it does not), `Constraint` requiring numeric fields (it does not — and that error had already cost that project eleven permanently-open gaps), and a claim of mine that `VIOLATES` was read by nothing. A skill whose first move is "record what they said" would have written four false facts into the graph, each carrying a real source's authority. NO EXISTING CAPTURE SKILL HAS A VERIFY STEP, because `capture-intent` takes the user's words AS intent by definition — right for intent, wrong for a report about a system that can be checked.

THE OPTIONS:

(a) A NEW `feedback` SKILL THAT ROUTES — a triage front door: verify what is checkable, search for the node that already holds it, then hand off to `capture-intent` (new intent), `brainstorm` (an idea), `governance-proposal` (a rule), `revise-design` (a change to something recorded), `reconcile_verification` (a test result), or a `TemporalFact` (a defect found by use). CHEAPEST TO DESCRIBE, and it matches his read that this is composition rather than new machinery. COUNTER: a router that only routes leaves the two hard steps — verify, and read authority — to judgement, which is exactly where today's four errors would have come from.

(b) A SKILL THAT DOES THE WHOLE JOB: verify → attribute authority → search → record → link provenance → report what was refuted. STRONGEST, and it captures what was actually derived twice. COUNTER: it duplicates chunks of four existing skills, and this project has been bitten before by instructions drifting out of step with the tools they describe.

(c) NO NEW SKILL; EXTEND `capture-intent` with a triage section. No 21st skill, and capture-intent is already the front door people reach for. COUNTER: capture-intent's contract is that the user's words ARE intent; bolting "first check whether they are true" onto that changes what the skill IS.

(d) DO NOTHING — the mapping table in `capture-intent` plus judgement covers it. COUNTER, measured: judgement produced the right answer twice today at considerable cost in re-derivation, and the same judgement also produced four claims that survived only because they were checked.

⚠️ COST THAT MUST BE WEIGHED: twenty skills already ship, and eleven had no slash command until recently. A 21st has to earn its place against the context every session pays.

⚠️ AND IT INHERITS AN UNRESOLVED PROBLEM: feedback usually arrives AS A DOCUMENT, and `rule:design-information-lives-in-the-graph-not-in-documents` is now enforced while `Fragment.content_ref` is explicitly a pointer "rather than inlining" the text. Until that is scoped, a feedback skill cannot say where a report's un-distilled remainder goes.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether feedback volume justifies a skill at all — three external reports in eight days is either a trend or a coincidence.
properties.name: IDEA — external feedback arrives undifferentiated: an idea, a test result, or the boss's word. Should reflow2 have a `feedback` skill that determines what it is and routes to the skills that already exist?
properties.rationale: Recorded via the brainstorm skill: one Decision per open question, at `proposed`, options with counters beside them, nothing promoted. Started as a new node rather than merged after the guard named three near matches — all three concern feedback LEAVING the project, and this is intake, which is the opposite direction and shares only the word. The two sharpenings — that authority rather than content is the harder discriminator, and that verification precedes recording — are findings from this session's measured work, stated as findings rather than as answers.
